Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The mass spectrometry experiment described in the PRIDE metadata and the 'Results' section (Figure S3C) is an affinity purification (pull-down) study to identify interacting proteins of overexpressed PD-L1. While the broader paper contains many differential comparisons (knockouts, drug treatments), the specific MS dataset provided in the PRIDE context is focused on the interaction proteome of PD-L1-Flag in HEK293 cells.

base_candidates_ranked.reason: The experiment used an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos for DDA (implied by 'detected, isolated, and fragmented') and the PRIDE metadata describes an affinity purification (AP-MS) of PD-L1-Flag. While no specific labeling is mentioned, the goal was to identify interacting proteins (UBE3C, UBE4A, MID-1), which typically follows a label-free or simple comparative DDA approach.

workflow: To identify which E3 ligases ubiquitinate PD-L1, we overexpressed PD-L1-Flag in HEK293 cells and used anti-Flag magnetic beads to pull down PD-L1 from cell lysates.
